title: 第17章迷踪林第18章你说谁对我好感提升了
slug: 我的民俗游戏机第227章权限
content_zh:
许峰看着师父将其打开，一阵一阵湍急的风就从这刀子上转了过来。
这风一出现，许峰就察觉到了不远处的树木，似有所动！
这一番，就算是许峰也不由自主的握住了手边之物，将铁锹死死的握住，另一只手摸在了脖子上的护身符上。
护身符之上，也有威仪散出，许峰打开了地图，在师父吐出此地名字之后，许峰也看到上面描上了一行地名。
【迷踪林】。
许峰问道：“师父，这是什么？”
师父手握着断刀，说道：“这就是我从你刘叔那里借来之物，上一辈用过的断刀。
刽子手的刀，和风水先生的罗盘不同，刽子手的刀，讲究一个世代相传。
可是有一样也是规矩，那就是这刀断了，就不能传了。这刀熔炼了再打成新刀也好，伴着上一辈子一起合在了坟里也罢。
再不济，或者是和魂瓶一起送走。
反正不能再留下了！
这一次，我借用此物，借此煞气，到这迷踪林里头走一圈。
你手握住了铁锹，伴我左右，不管听到，看到什么，都不许心慌，明白么？
心里牢记了这几个字，神鬼怕恶人，晓得么？”
许峰将铁锹拿了出来，望着眼前那虬髯怪扎，奇形百怪的树木，徐徐点头说道：“我明白了，师父！”
师父再度说道：“叫你得知，这一次咱们要做的，还是救‘人’。
这迷踪林下头，都是这些年死掉的尸体，人死了，魂儿也被囚在了这林子之中，久成祸患，这一番，要你小子将他们都启出来。
我就在旁边，为你压阵！要是遇见了问题——”
他复从自己身边拿出来了几个纸包，递给了许峰，许峰未曾见到游戏提示，故而问道：“师父，这是什么？”
师父说道：“这是社庙下头的香灰。你要是遇见了邪祟，莫管那么多，胆气提起来，一口中气呵斥出来，将此物丢在了那鬼祟的脸上即可，给我记住了！”

许峰将其收起来说道：“记得了，师父！”
师父点头，手持刀子站在前面，最后对着许峰说道：“怕不怕？”
许峰长呼出来了一口气说道：“不太怕，但是有些慌。”
师父闻言说道：“慌？那就更要去了，正所谓一回生二回熟，见的多了，也就知道都是那么一回事。
见鬼神第一步，便是不怕。
怕了，心火就灭了！心气就散了！无论如何，心气都不要散。”
随后他又低低的说道：“再说了，你师父还在哩，师父还在，你怕甚么？”
说罢，他带着许峰往前走，说道：“这一番将人启出来，埋了，烧了，就都是你的阴德。想要在缝尸这一行当走下去，阴德越多越好。缝尸人这个行当，也有个讲究。
是阴德庇佑，黄天不负。”
……
罗阴县城之中。
高瘦师父所见的那位火居道人，也就是周道长，此刻还在钱家的宅子里面。
不过此刻，他已经穿上了法衣，佩戴上了三清五佛冠，肃然站立！
周围乱糟糟的，周道长的徒弟，还有钱大有的仆人，都忙着搬东西。
钱老爷在道长背后，看着这道长的法衣。
这道长的法衣，是一片一片的碎布合起来的，这每一片碎布之上，都有名字，还都有一个手印，叫人看的眼馋！
content_en:
Xu Feng watched as his master opened it, and gusts of wind blew away from the knife.
As soon as the wind appeared, Xu Feng noticed that the trees not far away seemed to be moving!
At this time, even Xu Feng couldn't help but hold the thing at hand, tightly holding the shovel, and touched the amulet around his neck with his other hand.
There was also a majestic presence on the amulet. Xu Feng opened the map. After the master spit out the name of this place, Xu Feng also saw a line of place names traced on it.
【Mizong Forest】.
Xu Feng asked: "Master, what is this?"
The master held the broken knife in his hand and said: "This is what I borrowed from your Uncle Liu, the broken knife used by the previous generation.
The executioner's knife is different from the Feng Shui master's compass. The executioner's knife pays attention to being passed down from generation to generation.
But there is one rule, that is, if the sword is broken, it cannot be passed on. This sword may be smelted and then beaten into a new sword, or it may be buried in the grave with it for the rest of its life.
If not, it might be sent away with the soul bottle.
We can’t stay any longer anyway!
This time, I borrowed this object and used the evil spirit to walk around in the Lost Forest.
You hold the shovel in your hand and stay with me. No matter what you hear or see, don't panic, do you understand?
Keep these words in mind. Gods and ghosts are afraid of evil people, you know? "
Xu Feng took out the shovel, looked at the strangely thorny trees in front of him, nodded slowly and said, "I understand, Master!"
Master said again: "I want you to know that what we have to do this time is to save 'people'.
Under this Lost Forest, there are corpses that have died over the years. After people die, their souls are also imprisoned in this forest, which has become a disaster for a long time. Now, I want you to bring them all out.
I'm right next to you, holding the line for you! If you encounter a problem——"
He took out a few paper packets from his side and handed them to Xu Feng. Xu Feng had not seen the game prompt, so he asked: "Master, what is this?"
The master said: "This is the incense ashes at the bottom of the temple. If you encounter an evil spirit, don't worry so much. Get up your courage, scold it in one breath, and throw this thing on the evil spirit's face. Remember it!"
Xu Feng put it away and said, "I remember, Master!"
The master nodded, stood in front with a knife in his hand, and finally said to Xu Feng: "Are you afraid?"
Xu Feng took a long breath and said, "Not too scared, but a little panicked."
When the master heard this, he said: "Afraid? Then it's even more important to go. As the saying goes, once you learn something, you'll learn it twice. If you've seen it too much, you'll know it's all the same.
The first step to seeing ghosts and gods is not to be afraid.
If you are afraid, your inner fire will be extinguished! The anger is gone! No matter what, don't lose your temper. "
Then he said in a low voice: "Besides, your master is still here, your master is still here, what are you afraid of?"
After that, he led Xu Feng forward and said: "It's all your virtue to take people out, bury them, and burn them. If you want to continue in the business of sewing corpses, the more virtues you have, the better. There is also something special about the profession of sewing corpses.
It’s Yin De’s blessing, and Huang Tian lives up to it. "
…
In Luoyin County.
The Huoju Taoist whom the tall and thin master saw, Taoist Master Zhou, was still in the Qian family's house at the moment.
But at this moment, he has already put on the robes and the crown of the Three Pure Ones and Five Buddhas, standing solemnly!
There was a mess all around. Daozhang Zhou's apprentices and wealthy servants were all busy moving things.
Mr. Qian was behind the Taoist Priest, looking at the Taoist Priest's cassock.
This long cassock is made up of pieces of rags. Each piece of rag has a name and a fingerprint on it, which makes people greedy to see!
